maddeler.e:
احترفوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَرَفُوا (iḥtarafū) /iħ.ta.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# اُحْتُرِفُوا (uḥturifū) /uħ.tu.ri.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# اِحْتَرِفُوا (iḥtarifū) /iħ.ta.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
